failure_modes.what: Expired JWT on /costs/* and /pallets/*: Worker answers 401 {error:"Unauthorized"}; ctFetch/plFetch throw that text (or "HTTP 401" when the body is not JSON). No redirect to login, no session clear, no logError — only /v0 calls via _atRetry redirect.
failure_modes.gap: The user sees an error card on Έξοδα/Μισθοδοσία/Παλέτες/TRIP PnL but nothing central records it; B-37 has no source.

failure_modes.what: Offline: atPatch/atCreate/atDelete queue the write and RETURN success-shaped objects ({_offline:true}, id "offline_<ts>"). Chains continue with a fake id (links written to "offline_…" are rejected later or dropped).
failure_modes.gap: No central signal: the queue lives in one browser localStorage.

failure_modes.what: Flush replays with raw fetch and never checks res.ok: a 401/403/422 on replay counts as "synced"; the item is removed from the queue. Conflict check reads "Last Modified", which no facade table exposes -> never detects a conflict.
failure_modes.gap: A queued change rejected by the server disappears with a green «N αλλαγές συγχρονίστηκαν».

failure_modes.what: Queue cap 50: 51st change is dropped (toast + logError) — logError posts only if online, which it is not.
failure_modes.gap: Local toast only; the app_errors row is never sent while offline.

failure_modes.what: Undo of a delete re-creates the record with atCreate -> NEW legacy_id; links pointing to the old id stay on the soft-deleted row; for ORDERS the cascade (stops, NL, GL, CL, ramp, pallets) is not restored; computed labels in the saved fields are dropped (-> facade_unknown_fields write).
failure_modes.gap: Toast says «Restored …»; nothing reports the orphaned links.

failure_modes.what: atSuppressUndo has no caller (only orders_intl sets _atSuppressUndo directly): in every other cascade the LAST sub-write becomes the undo target, so «Αναίρεση» reverts a side table, not the user edit. Undo pre-state comes from memory cache only.
failure_modes.gap: Nobody would notice until an undo restores the wrong thing.

failure_modes.what: atSafePatch (71 call sites) never checks conflicts: _recordVersions is filled only by atTrackVersion (no callers) and by its own result, whose "Last Modified" is always null. It is atPatch with a misleading name (principle 8).
failure_modes.gap: Two dispatchers overwrite each other with no warning.

failure_modes.what: audit()/auditMany() swallow the insert error (console.error only) and the handler returns 200/201. /pallets/override has NO other trace: its only record is the audit row, yet it answers {recorded:true}.
failure_modes.gap: Only CF console logs, which nothing reads; B-35 catches total silence, not a single missing row.

failure_modes.what: app_errors forwarding is capped at 20 per page load, skipped on localhost/127.0.0.1, fire-and-forget (.catch swallows), sends no sw_version and no role. index.html loads no utils.js, so login-page errors never reach the table (the utils.js comment claiming otherwise is stale).
failure_modes.gap: The 21st error of a render loop and every login-page error are invisible centrally.

failure_modes.what: The Error Log page reads localStorage tms_errors of the owner's own browser, never GET /app-errors (no front caller exists). logError also overwrites tms_errors with the in-memory array of the current page load (never hydrated at boot unless the purge removed something), so history is lost on the first new error after a reload.
failure_modes.gap: Owner believes he sees «the errors»; he sees only his own, only since his last reload.

failure_modes.what: safeFetch drops errors whose message is "Unauthorized" without logging (by design, 6/9) — also hides a 401 that is not session expiry (e.g. JWT_SECRET rotation).
failure_modes.gap: A Worker secret rotation would log out everyone with zero app_errors rows.

failure_modes.what: rule gl-never-deleted: DB RESTRICT protects only against hard DELETE of the parent; facade DELETE is an UPDATE deleted_at, and owner "*" includes DELETE -> owner can soft-delete GL rows. The Worker comment «The DB also refuses it» is untrue for soft-delete.
failure_modes.gap: No check counts GL rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

failure_modes.what: Wildcard replaces (604): any new facade table opens GET to management/accountant automatically; an explicit row that omits a method removes it (accountant.order_stops has no POST/DELETE; accountant.pallet_ledger_partners falls to "*": GET while _suppliers has POST/PATCH).
failure_modes.gap: Opening is silent (born open, principle 5); removal is a 403 toast.

failure_modes.what: /health returns a static OK without touching Supabase; Origin gate lets requests with NO Origin through (only /app-errors POST requires one).
failure_modes.gap: A dead DB or missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY still reports healthy.

failure_modes.gap: Which app version each device runs is unknowable centrally.
